shortDescription: Manages STP configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: bpdu_filter
options.description: Specify a port as a BPDU filter port.

options.name: bpdu_protection
options.description: Configure BPDU protection on an edge port. This function prevents network flapping caused by attack packets.

options.name: cost
options.description: Set the path cost of the current port. The default instance is 0.

options.name: edged_port
options.description: Set the current port as an edge port.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface name. If the value is C(all), will apply configuration to all interfaces. if the value is a special name, only support input the full name.

options.name: loop_protection
options.description: Enable loop protection on the current port.

options.name: root_protection
options.description: Enable root protection on the current port.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: stp_converge
options.description: STP convergence mode. Fast means set STP aging mode to Fast. Normal means set STP aging mode to Normal.

options.name: stp_enable
options.description: Enable or disable STP on a switch.

options.name: stp_mode
options.description: Set an operation mode for the current MSTP process. The mode can be STP, RSTP, or MSTP.

options.name: tc_protection
options.description: Configure the TC BPDU protection function for an MSTP process.

options.name: tc_protection_interval
options.description: Set the time the MSTP device takes to handle the maximum number of TC BPDUs and immediately refresh forwarding entries. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 600, in seconds.

options.name: tc_protection_threshold
options.description: Set the maximum number of TC BPDUs that the MSTP can handle. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255. The default value is 1 on the switch.
